webster-revanced.description: Merriam-Webster Morphe builds upon the original Merriam-Webster Dictionary app by Merriam-Webster Inc., a comprehensive English dictionary with definitions, synonyms, antonyms, audio pronunciations, voice search, Word of the Day, and example sentences. This modification applies the 'Enable Premium' patch from the hoo-dles custom ReVanced repository to the package com.merriamwebster, bypassing subscription costs for enhanced access without specific version requirements. Users unlock ad-free experience, additional content (e.g., more entries, illustrations in related premium variants), and full premium features like expanded thesauri or no third-party ads, though functionality may vary depending on the exact premium tier targeted.
